regime.label: Risk-Off
regime.description: VIX at 27.4, grinding higher. Nasdaq enters correction (-10% from peak). Regime deepening risk-off. DXY below 100 reflects US credibility erosion. Bond yields steepening on inflation fears.

watchlist.thesis: Gold supercycle buy-the-dip after correction. $4,453/oz, structural bid intact with VIX elevated and dollar weak.
Energy only sector in green. Direct hedge against Iran/Hormuz risk. Brent above $100 = elevated earnings.
AI chip pivot confirmed. Needham upgrade to Buy ($200 PT). Barclays OW $165. Momentum post-reveal.
Long-duration bonds as recession hedge. At $86.11, yields at 4.94% on 30Y. Risk/reward improves if PCE cools.
Correction short. Below 50d and 200d MA. Next support $560. Rising yields hostile to high-PE tech.
At $68.5K, testing 200d MA ($66K). Break below confirms bear market. High correlation with SPX (0.72).

events.label: Q1 End — Window Dressing + Rebalancing
events.detail: Q1 penultimate day. Portfolio managers window-dress with energy outperformers. Elevated volume expected on BTU, VLO, LNG.

events.label: Q1 Final Day + Consumer Confidence
events.detail: Q1 close + Conference Board Consumer Confidence (10AM ET). Weak reading = defensive rotation accelerates.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Apr 1)
events.detail: Critical stagflation gauge. Sub-50 reading confirms oil-driven slowdown and boosts defensives.

events.label: ADP Employment + OPEC+ Monitor (Apr 2)
events.detail: ADP payrolls 8:15AM ET. OPEC+ may announce emergency output increase — watch oil price reaction.

events.label: Non-Farm Payrolls (Apr 3)
events.detail: Strong NFP = higher-for-longer rates. Weak NFP = recession fears. Either scenario supports energy and defensives.

opportunities.label: Energy Sector — Q1 Window Dressing
opportunities.detail: Portfolio managers showing energy exposure at quarter-end. BTU, VLO, LNG, EQNR historically see elevated buying pressure in final 2 days of Q1.

opportunities.label: US LNG — Marginal Supply Source for Europe/Asia
opportunities.detail: Persian Gulf gas stranded behind Hormuz blockade. JPMorgan raised LNG target to $279 (pre-escalation). Supply inelasticity = structural premium.

opportunities.label: Gold Miners — Lagging Metal (Catch-Up Trade)
opportunities.detail: Gold at $4,521. Miners systematically lagging the metal. Catch-up potential when momentum resumes. GDX/NEM positioned for mean reversion.
